result.reason: The operative addition supplies all preferred warranties, durations, and remedies; its longer periods necessarily satisfy the fallback periods as well. It is narrowly directed to the identified warranty gaps and leaves the existing Year 2000 warranty and disclaimer structure effective. Drafting is generally strong, although the remedy provision does not specify which party selects among repair, replacement, and refund, and replacement is somewhat awkward as a remedy for services.
